description: This file contains PHPUnit test cases for the LeaveEntitlementService class within the OrangeHRM human resource management system. It includes test methods for strategy retrieval, entitlement management, and leave balance calculations, as well as fixture loading and mock setup.

classes.name: LeaveEntitlementServiceTest
classes.description: Test class for the LeaveEntitlementService, including setup and various test methods for strategies, entitlement management, and leave balances.

classes.name: TestEntitlementConsumptionStrategy
classes.description: A mock implementation of the EntitlementConsumptionStrategy interface for testing purposes.

classes.name: InvalidLeaveEntitlementConsumptionStrategy
classes.description: A dummy class representing an invalid strategy implementation used for error testing.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the LeaveEntitlementService instance before each test.

methods.name: testGetLeaveEntitlementStrategy
methods.description: Tests retrieving the leave entitlement strategy when configuration provides a valid class.

methods.name: testGetLeaveEntitlementStrategyNonExistClass
methods.description: Tests error handling when the configured class does not exist.

methods.name: testGetLeaveEntitlementStrategyInvalidClass
methods.description: Tests error handling when the configured class does not implement the expected interface.

methods.name: testGetLeaveEntitlementDao
methods.description: Verifies that the DAO returned by the service is an instance of LeaveEntitlementDao.

methods.name: testGetDeletableIdsFromEntitlementIds
methods.description: Tests filtering of entitlement IDs based on whether they are deletable (no days used).

methods.name: getDeletableIdsFromEntitlementIdsDataProvider
methods.description: Data provider with various test cases for entitlement ID deletability.

methods.name: testGetLeaveBalanceWithDates
methods.description: Verifies that leave balance retrieval with specific start and end dates works correctly.

methods.name: testGetLeaveBalanceWithOnlyEndDate
methods.description: Tests leave balance retrieval when only the end date is specified.

methods.name: testGetLeaveBalanceWithOnlyAsAtDate
methods.description: Tests leave balance retrieval with only the 'as at' date specified, including strategy checks.

methods.name: testGetLeaveBalanceWithOnlyAsAtDateLeavePeriodNotForced
methods.description: Tests leave balance retrieval when leave period is not forced, and no strategy is used.

methods.name: testAddEntitlementForEmployeeAsNew
methods.description: Tests adding entitlement for a new employee record.

methods.name: testAddEntitlementForEmployeeAsAdding
methods.description: Tests adding entitlement when record already exists, ensuring accumulation.

methods.name: testAddEntitlementForEmployeeAsAddingWhenDeletedAlsoThere
methods.description: Tests entitlement addition when existing record is marked as deleted, ensuring proper crediting.

methods.name: testBulkAssignLeaveEntitlements
methods.description: Tests bulk assignment of leave entitlements to multiple employees.

methods.name: loadFixtures
methods.description: Loads test fixture data into the database for testing.
